messages:
zoe: Quick note from staging: we saw billing delta spikes when splitter normalized dims for certain tenants. Need policy on billing attribution.
anya: saw it. Two options: (1) bill post-split (actual bytes served), (2) bill original request units and absorb cost in infra. Both have tradeoffs.
li: post-split aligns with infra cost but will confuse customers unless console shows both estimates. Can we emit preflight.billing_hint?
mike: console UX: show "Estimated units (original)" vs "Estimated units (post-split)" with a delta badge. Also add a tooltip explaining why numbers differ.
billing-svc: we can emit embed.billing.estimate.before and embed.billing.estimate.after events. If tenant opts into "preserve_units" flag, we can override billing, but need contractual opt-in.
zoe: sample error/fastfail for oversize that includes suggested action:
```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"embed_oversize","max_bytes":8388608,"suggested_action":"preflight or toggle split=true","suggested_chunk":512}
```
anya: headers: X-Embed-Preflight: SPLIT|REJECT|PASS, X-Embed-PostSplit-Units: 12345. These help console and telemetry.
li: telemetry schema suggestion:
embed.preflight => tenant_id|request_id|dims_list|est_before|est_after|plan_hash
embed.split => request_id|chunks|chunk_bytes|applied_strategy
embed.billing.estimate => request_id|est_before|est_after
mike: alert rules: if avg(est_after/est_before) > 1.2 for >15m and split_rate > 3% trigger billing review alert to #finance-ops and auto-disable canary.
alert-bot: added alert rule "embed.billing.delta" with threshold 1.2 for 15m and scopes=canary
zoe: rate-limit concerns: preflight should be cheaper but we must cap preflight per-tenant to avoid DOS. Suggest default 20 preflights/min per tenant, can be raised for enterprise.
anya: SDK change: add embed_opts={split:true, prefer_chunk:512, bill_preserve:false}. Default split=false for now.
billing-svc: will add an audit log entry when tenant toggles bill_preserve and emit billing.opt_in event.
li: rollout: enable splitter.v3 flag for 10% tenants, collect embed.billing.estimate.* events, split_rate, p95 latency. Canary tag embed-split-accounting.
mike: Console work: add side-panel "Split impact" on route diagnostics and a "Recompute preview" button that calls preflight.
zoe: follow-ups assigned: Zoe (policy + RFC), Anya (SDK), Li (telemetry + rate-limits), Mike (console panel), Billing-svc (audit + opt-in flow).
zoe: timeline: RFC by Tue, canary in 1 week. Thanks!
